Game Overview

In Zombies Cookies Apocalypse, the core idea is straightforward: survive a cookie-craving undead onslaught in Zombies Cookies Apocalypse. Navigate zombie-packed streets, collect cookies, and outwit the monstrous horde. Plan each move strategically, harness power-ups, and balance speed with survival in this unique twist on apocalypse action. Can you safeguard the beloved treats?
